players.product: Large-scale liquid-cooled AI data-center campuses (Polaris Forge / Delta Forge)

quarterly_data.signal: Fiscal Q1 2027 earnings release: as of August 31, 2026 Applied Digital has leases for approximately 1.41 GW of critical IT load across five campuses (Polaris Forge 1, 2 and 3 in North Dakota, Delta Forge 1 in Louisiana, Delta Forge 2 in Alabama), representing approximately $36 billion of contracted revenue over their initial base terms, or approximately $86 billion if all renewal options are exercised. The HPC Hosting Business produced $33.4 million of segment operating profit for the quarter ended August 31, 2026. In the Data Center Hosting Business (energized space for crypto mining customers), the 106 MW facility in Jamestown, ND and the 180 MW facility in Ellendale, ND were operating at full capacity as of August 31, 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: approximately $36 billion contracted revenue over initial base terms, approximately $86 billion with all renewal options; HPC Hosting segment operating profit $33.4 million; 106 MW Jamestown and 180 MW Ellendale at full capacity
